## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 26, 2026 - Sep 28, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Catherine Swidinski_, Sep 28, 2026, 1/5: "This app is untrustworthy!! Don't believe their sales pitch! I cancelled my subscription and was still charged on my credit card!! When I asked for a refund, they told me I wasn't getting one and tried to persuade me to buy more products from them instead. I cannot speak to a person, it is all AI!!"
            2. _Sue Mullen_, Sep 28, 2026, 4/5: "***Update - customer service reached out and issued credits ~ very responsive and professional - thank you!! I've been billed 3 times in the past 3 months...the Contact Us button on your website is a joke. I've gone in and canceled my subscription (which I thought I did last year), but I'd really like to get my overpayments refunded (not using the app at all)."
            3. _Judith Williams_, Sep 26, 2026, 5/5: "I absolutely love Lasta & was able to try it at a discounted price for the 1st month, however, it is too expensive on a monthly basis for me to continue"
